crossRefs.note: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
“Am I a God at hand,” says Yahweh, “and not a God afar off?
Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says…
“I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith…

parallels.note: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.

translations.web: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.
translations.bsb: But I know your sitting down, your going out and coming in, and your raging against Me.
translations.kjv: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage
translations.asv: But I know thy sitting down, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy raging against me.
